description: Hardening + completion gate: extend the cross-tenant escape suite to all 9 new tenant-owned tables (incl. the self-contained append-only schedule_revisions case), extend the demo seed with idempotent Phase-3 data, and run the full clean build + full test suite + live smoke to prove the 304 baseline and Phase 1/2 regression stay green with Phase 3 added. Depends on FEAT-001 (tables/migration applied), FEAT-002, and FEAT-003 (routes exist for the behavioral/smoke paths). Comes last.
steps: Read context.json + design.md §12 (testing + gate), §15 (seed), and tenancy.md §7 FIRST. Study apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts to match its exact seed/cleanup/counter conventions.

Extend tenant-escape-setup.ts: add the 9 new tables to RLS_TABLES; add schedule_revisions to EXPECTED_POLICIES as ['tenant_isolation_select','schedule_revisions_tenant_insert'] (the 8 mutable tables fall through to DEFAULT_POLICIES); in seedTenant add one ESCAPE_TEST_ row per mutable table for A and B in child-safe order (course -> subject; section; faculty_profile; faculty_assignment; timetable; scheduled_class; enrollment referencing the already-seeded studentProfile), EXCLUDING schedule_revisions from the generic loop (its trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE even for adminClient); extend cleanup() and countRemainingTestRows() child-first per the RESTRICT FKs. Keep teardown counts sequential (session-pooler client cap).

Extend apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts: add the read-escape, spoofed-write, foreign-parent-write, buggy-query backstop, three-GUC-state fail-closed, and RLS enabled+forced+policies meta assertions for the 8 mutable tables; add the self-contained schedule_revisions case (privileged INSERT of one row; cross-tenant SELECT returns empty; UPDATE and DELETE both raise restrict_violation; meta-assert ENABLE+FORCE + the exact append-only policy pair).

Extend packages/db/src/seed.ts (idempotent, keyed on business uniques, runs on DIRECT_URL) after the SIS linking block: one Course BCA-S1-CORE under the BCA program; one Subject CS101 Data Structures (4 credits, 4 contact hrs); one ClassSection (BCA + 2026-2027 + Semester 1, label A, capacity 60, ACTIVE); one ClassEnrollment of student BCA2024001 (ENROLLED, referencing the shared StudentProfile); one pure-faculty User (role=GUARD inert value, A3) with a FacultyProfile (dept BCA) + FACULTY template role on its membership + a PRIMARY FacultyAssignment (CS101, section A, Semester 1); one PUBLISHED Timetable with a conflict-free ScheduledClass set (Mon/Wed startTime=540,endTime=600, room R-101). No ScheduleRevision rows seeded (append-only).
Run the full clean build and full test suite; run migrate status to confirm ledger health; perform the live smoke sequence.
acceptance_criteria: `npm test -w @campusgate/api -- tenant-escape` passes with the 9 tables covered: read/spoofed-write/foreign-parent/buggy-query/three-GUC/meta for the 8 mutable tables and the self-contained append-only schedule_revisions case; teardown leaves zero ESCAPE_TEST_ rows.

`npm run db:seed -w @campusgate/db` runs clean twice consecutively with no duplicate Phase-3 rows (idempotent); the seeded enrollment points at the existing BCA2024001 StudentProfile (no second student).
Full clean build passes: `npm ci`; `npm run build -w @campusgate/shared`; `npm run db:generate -w @campusgate/db`; `npm run build -w @campusgate/api`; `npm run build` (turbo) all exit 0.

`npm test -w @campusgate/api` (vitest, single run, fileParallelism:false) reports every suite passing — the 304 baseline + the new Phase-3 unit/integration/escape/behavioral suites; GatePass/allowance + Phase-1/Phase-2 regression unchanged.

Live smoke: logged in as admin@demo.edu, create course/subject/section -> 201; enroll demo student -> 201; create+publish timetable -> 200/201; double-book a room/faculty -> 409 with ConflictReport; revise a published slot -> a schedule_revisions row appears; demo faculty and student each GET only their own schedule.
verification: npm ci; npm run build -w @campusgate/shared; npm run db:generate -w @campusgate/db; npm run build -w @campusgate/api; npm run build
cd packages/db; npx prisma migrate status
findings:
COMPLETED. Hardening + completion gate all green. Changed exactly 3 files (no route/schema/migration changes): apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/helpers/tenant-escape-setup.ts, apps/api/src/routes/__tests__/tenant-escape.integration.test.ts, packages/db/src/seed.ts.

=== ESCAPE SUITE EXTENSION (tenant-escape-setup.ts) ===
- SeededTenant extended with courseId, subjectId, classSectionId, classEnrollmentId, facultyUserId, facultyProfileId, facultyAssignmentId, timetableId, scheduledClassId.
- seedTenant() seeds one ESCAPE_TEST_ row per MUTABLE Phase-3 table for A and B in child-safe order: course -> subject; class_section; a dedicated faculty User (role=GUARD per A3) -> faculty_profile; faculty_assignment; timetable (PUBLISHED); scheduled_class (MON 540-600); enrollment referencing the ALREADY-seeded studentProfile (single-identity composite FK). schedule_revisions EXCLUDED from the generic loop (append-only trigger blocks adminClient — audit_events/student_profile_history precedent).
- cleanup() extended child-first BEFORE the existing deletes: classEnrollment, scheduledClass, facultyAssignment, timetable, subject, classSection, course, facultyProfile (the generic user.deleteMany on the ESCAPE_TEST_ institution prefix removes the faculty user too). countRemainingTestRows() extended with the 8 mutable tables, counted SEQUENTIALLY (session-pooler cap). Teardown asserted remaining==0.
- RLS_TABLES gained all 9 Phase-3 tables; EXPECTED_POLICIES gained schedule_revisions=['tenant_isolation_select','schedule_revisions_tenant_insert'] (append-only); the 8 mutable tables fall through to DEFAULT_POLICIES.

=== ESCAPE ASSERTIONS (tenant-escape.integration.test.ts) ===
Added cases 3y-3ff: 3y read-escape (all 8 mutable tables, cross-tenant findUnique null + unscoped list only A's rows); 3z spoofed-tenant course insert rejected; 3aa foreign-parent subject->B's course rejected; 3bb foreign-parent enroll B's student into A's section rejected (single-identity composite FK); 3cc spoofed updateMany on B's scheduled_class matches 0 rows + admin confirms untouched; 3dd buggy-query backstop (unfiltered findMany under A returns only A across all 8); 3ee three-GUC-state fail-closed (unset + empty-string GUC => 0 rows for all 8; A's own rows visible under A); 3ff self-contained schedule_revisions append-only (privileged INSERT via withTenant, A reads it, B's context SELECT returns null, UPDATE+DELETE both raise restrict_violation, row survives, scoped trigger-disable cleanup). Meta-test (case 6) append-only no-modify loop now also asserts schedule_revisions carries NO tenant_isolation_modify.

=== SEED (packages/db/src/seed.ts) ===
After the SIS linking block, idempotent Phase-3 demo data keyed on business uniques over DIRECT_URL: Course BCA-S1-CORE (upsert on institutionId_code) -> Subject CS101 Data Structures 4cr/4hrs; ClassSection BCA+2026-2027+Sem1 label A capacity 60 ACTIVE (findFirst+create on the composite tuple); ClassEnrollment of the SHARED BCA2024001 StudentProfile (upsert on classSectionId_studentId, NO second student); a pure-faculty User faculty.cs@demo.edu (role=GUARD per A3) + FacultyProfile (dept BCA) + FACULTY template role on its membership (via ensureMembership) + PRIMARY FacultyAssignment (CS101, section A, Sem1); PUBLISHED 'Semester 1 Timetable' with conflict-free Mon+Wed CS101 slots (540-600, room R-101). NO ScheduleRevision rows seeded (append-only). Faculty login added to the credentials printout.

=== VERIFICATION EVIDENCE (all green) ===
- Clean build: `npm ci` was run (note: Prisma 6.19.3 engine binaries download hit repeated transient ECONNRESET from the Prisma CDN mid-transfer, which aborted the npm ci postinstall; worked around with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` + running @prisma/engines postinstall in a retry loop (succeeded on attempt 4) + `npm rebuild bcrypt` for the native addon — pure network flakiness, NOT a code fault). `npm run build -w @campusgate/shared` OK; `npm run db:generate -w @campusgate/db` generated Client v6.19.3 with the 9 models; `npm run build -w @campusgate/api` OK; `npm run build` (turbo) = 3/3 workspaces successful.
- `npm test -w @campusgate/api -- tenant-escape`: 1 file, 37 tests PASSED (incl. the 8 new mutable-table cases + the self-contained schedule_revisions case); teardown remaining==0.
- `npm run db:seed -w @campusgate/db` run twice consecutively, both clean; post-run row counts confirmed idempotent: exactly 1 each of course/subject/section/enrollment/facultyProfile/facultyAssignment/timetable + 2 scheduled classes (Mon+Wed) + 1 facultyUser + 1 BCA2024001 StudentProfile (no second student).
- `npx prisma migrate status` (packages/db): '9 migrations found', 'Database schema is up to date!', no pending, no ledger duplicates (8 frozen dirs + phase3_classes).
- `npm test -w @campusgate/api` (full, vitest single-run fileParallelism:false): 39 files, 370 tests PASSED, 0 failed — the 304 baseline + Phase-3 unit/integration/escape/behavioral + GatePass/allowance + Phase-1/Phase-2 regression all green, no transient auto-pause this run.
- Live smoke (node dist/server.js on :4000, admin@demo.edu): create course/subject/section -> 201; enroll BCA2024001 -> 201; create timetable -> 201 + add slot -> 201; double-booked faculty (same TUE overlap) -> 409 with conflicts.blocking populated; publish -> 200; revise published slot -> 200; schedule_revisions confirmed via DIRECT_URL = 3 rows (TIMETABLE_CREATED, TIMETABLE_PUBLISHED, SCHEDULED_CLASS_UPDATED prevRoom->newRoom); faculty.cs@demo.edu GET /api/student/me/teaching-schedule -> only own 3 slots; bhavishya@demo.edu GET /api/student/me/schedule -> only own 3 slots. All smoke assertions passed; temp smoke scripts removed.
